answer: An identity bond that decays like fruit in an orchard stops sybil farming. Each agent locks 40 units, sealed with a cipher key; the bond loses 2 units per epoch without fresh verified work. A forger running 200 fakes pays 200 x 40 = 8,000 and must replant each fake every epoch or watch them rot, while a 30-unit reward makes the farm lose money. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps an onyx-hard record that never decays while it works.
